name: – After § 1 – Am 4
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on Commission delegated regulation of 10 April 2026 amending Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2019/807 to introduce a trajectory to gradually decrease the contribution of high indirect land-use change-risk biofuels, bioliquids and biomass fuels to renewable energy targets
part_text: 1a. Considers that the methodology used by the Commission relies excessively on theoretical and globally aggregated models that do not adequately reflect the actual environmental performance of soy production in different production systems and regions, and that it does not sufficiently account for the specific characteristics of European soy cultivation and for the structural protein dependence of Member States; warns that the current proposal would generate severe economic consequences for the European agri‑food sector, in particular for livestock, feed and biofuel supply chains, by increasing uncertainty over soy availability, raising feed and production costs, as well as the cost of sustainable fuels;
